scope: Selected passages in an already cached public-domain English verse translation. No entire book read; no new asset, software or book download; no historical reconstruction claim.

source.title: The Ramayana of Valmiki, translated into English verse

claim_boundaries: Lanka description supports literary gold gates/walls, coastal greenery, broad streets, domes/turrets, lotus pools and moats.
Pampa's clear water/reeds/sedge are a separate scene, not evidence that Lanka is a swamp.
Terracotta material, shallow West Reed Court, map layout and all movement/attack rules are original adaptation decisions.
No modern geography, archaeology, sacred-site reconstruction or present-day community identity is inferred.
